query: SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('modelId',m.model_id,'family',m.family,'track',m.track,'createdAt',m.created_at,'firstSeenAt',m.first_seen_at,'lastSeenAt',m.last_seen_at,'active',m.active,'new',NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ops.provider_model_upgrade_receipts r WHERE r.target_model_id=m.model_id AND r.outcome='APPLIED')) ORDER BY m.created_at DESC NULLS LAST,m.model_id ASC),'[]'::jsonb) FROM ops.relay_model_catalog m
